name: AlienFX
author: 3mrgnc3
description: Alienware RGB lighting with a theme-synced diagonal gradient across the keyboard and chassis zones.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one panel: per-key keyboard gradient, chassis zones, brightness and vibrancy, firmware effects, saved profiles, and a guided keymap wizard for any Alienware model.

schema.label: alienfx-ctl path
schema.description: Leave empty to use ~/.local/bin/alienfx-ctl, where the installer puts it.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: A single glyph for the bar. Leave empty for the alien head.
